class.name: TeXRender
class.brief_description: Lays out and draws a LaTeX math expression on a [CanvasItem].
class.description: Call [method parse] on the main thread to create a layout. Keep the [TeXRender] instance to measure it and draw it repeatedly. Call [method draw] from [method CanvasItem._draw] or a [signal CanvasItem.draw] callback. Use [constant STYLE_TEXT] for inline math. Use [method get_baseline_offset] to align the formula with the baseline of surrounding text.

method.name: clear
method.description: Clears the layout, its settings, and the last error.

method.name: draw
method.description: Draws the current layout with its top-left corner at [param position] in [param canvas]'s local coordinates. After drawing, the canvas item's draw transform is set to identity.

method.name: get_baseline
method.description: Returns the baseline position as a fraction of the layout height. Returns [code]0.0[/code] for an empty layout.

method.name: get_baseline_offset
method.description: Returns the distance from the top of the layout to its baseline in pixels, measured using the layout's integer height.

method.name: get_depth
method.description: Returns the depth below the baseline in pixels, including any bottom inset and padding.

method.name: get_height
method.description: Returns the total layout height in pixels.

method.name: get_insets
method.description: Returns the effective insets in left, top, right, bottom order. Includes MicroTeX's automatic insets when enabled.

method.name: get_render_error
method.description: Returns the error message from the last parse attempt, or an empty string on success.

method.name: get_size
method.description: Returns the total layout size in pixels.

method.name: get_text_size
method.description: Returns the current text size in pixels, or [code]0.0[/code] when there is no layout.

method.name: get_width
method.description: Returns the total layout width in pixels.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a formula layout is available.

method.name: parse
method.description: Replaces the current layout with the parsed LaTeX expression and returns [constant OK] on success. Empty or whitespace-only input clears the layout and returns [constant OK]. A parse error clears the layout and can be read with [method get_render_error].

method.name: set_foreground
method.description: Changes the foreground of the current layout. A fully transparent color uses MicroTeX's default foreground. Colors specified in the expression still apply.

method.name: set_height
method.description: Expands the layout to at least [param height] pixels, positioning the formula at the top, center, or bottom of the extra space.

method.name: set_insets
method.description: Sets insets in left, top, right, bottom order. When [param true_values] is [code]false[/code], MicroTeX adds its automatic padding to the specified values. Pass [code]Vector4i(0, 0, 0, 0), true[/code] for tight inline layout.

method.name: set_text_size
method.description: Scales the current formula to [param text_size] pixels. Insets keep their current pixel values.

method.name: set_width
method.description: Expands the layout to at least [param width] pixels, positioning the formula at the left, center, or right of the extra space.
